scenario.summary: Ransomware operators including Qilin and Inc exploit CVE-2026-0257 to bypass authentication on Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect gateways, establishing unauthorized VPN sessions. Attackers then pivot to the virtualization layer (vCenter/ESXi) to disable security controls and perform offline credential dumping against domain controller virtual disks before deploying ransomware.

hunt.name: Virtualization Pivot and Host Encryption
hunt.description: The adversary exploits PAN-OS and pivots from the VPN gateway to the virtualization and backup infrastructure. This hunt targets the sophisticated post-access tradecraft observed following this exploitation. It examines the use of dual-use RMM tools for reconnaissance, identifies lateral movement toward vCenter and backup infrastructure, and detects the pivot to the ESXi hypervisor layer where security controls are disabled. Finally, it looks for the characteristic file encryption patterns of ransomware families like Qilin and Inc that occur after credentials have been harvested from virtual disks. The analyst reviews these correlated signals to stop the impact before it reaches the full fleet.
